Rule: All mandatory requisition fields complete before approval
No duplicate candidate by verified email and phone after matching
Country, job-family, source and stage use canonical codes
Hub stage and partner status agree for assessment, interview and check orders
Partner result recorded within [15] minutes of partner completion
Hire data matches signed offer for pay, start date and position
Decision reason present for every reject or withdraw
Offer pay inside band; currency present
Consent withdrawal reaches all partners within [24] hours
Every AI event has model version, reasons and human decision
Action on failure: Block use of the AI step

Rule: Check records hold outcome and date only
Employee ID returned and stored for every completed hire
Clearance flag present before start for safety-critical roles
Retention job runs monthly; no record kept beyond rule
